thread:
maria.g: Quick sync: follow-up from the 2026-03-18 postmortem about paging storm. Need owners, acceptance criteria, and firm deadlines so we can close the postmortem actions. Root causes: high-cardinality errors + too-aggressive latency thresholds.

sam.k: I can own dedupe rule changes (query-level) and the staging test harness. Goal: validate in staging for 48h. Aiming to open PR by EOD Thu. :thumbsup:

lucas.r: I'll take thresholds and SLO alignment. Plan: compute per-route latency histograms over last 30 days and propose new alert buckets. Need the eval dataset and permission to run synthetic loads. @maria.g can you share the artifacts?

maria.g: Shared: https://wiki.redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-03-18-noisy-pages and the sample query set in the shared drive. I've added a link in the postmortem issue.

priya.v: I'll lead paging policy updates: suggest moving low-impact routes to async paging (PD low) and adding a 10m suppression window for similar errors. Will draft the policy doc and update PD routing.

dennis.s: I'll handle Alertmanager normalization: dedupe label sets and ensure we don't drop tenant identifiers. Will update runbook with verification steps.

sam.k: Example change I'll test in a small PR to collapse per-request noise by changing the dedupe fingerprint:
```yaml
- alert: HighWorkerErrors
  expr: sum by (job,error_type) (increase(worker_errors_total[5m])) > 50
  labels:
    dedupe_fingerprint: "{{ job }}:{{ error_type }}"
```
This ignores request_id in the fingerprint so similar errors group.

lucas.r: From histograms the 95th for some routes spikes due to retry storms. Proposal: raise latency threshold from 200ms -> 400ms for non-customer-facing internal routes and add slow_request_rate alert using rate() over 10m. Will post numbers + rationale in 30m.

maria.g: Please post acceptance criteria and deadlines here. I want the loop closed by next Tuesday. Also we'll schedule a 15m check-in Mon 10:00.

sam.k: Acceptance: dedupe change reduces pages for rule HighWorkerErrors by >=70% in staging over 48h. Deadline: 2026-03-31.

lucas.r: Acceptance: latency alert false positives <=5% on evaluation set; dashboard churn reduced. Deadline: 2026-03-30.

priya.v: Acceptance: paging policy updated, doc + PD escalation mapping changed, 7-day pilot with designated service owner. Deadline: 2026-03-29.

dennis.s: Acceptance: Alertmanager label normalization applied, no cross-tenant suppression, runbook updated with rollback. Deadline: 2026-03-28.

maria.g: Recap of actions (added to the issue): 1) sam.k 7 dedupe PR + staging test (due 2026-03-31). 2) lucas.r 7 thresholds + synthetic test (due 2026-03-30). 3) priya.v 7 paging policy + pilot (due 2026-03-29). 4) dennis.s 7 Alertmanager normalization + runbook (due 2026-03-28). 5) maria.g 7 create issue, notify CS, schedule follow-up (done).

pagerduty-bot: Incident follow-up created: INC-2026-4455. Notification sent to primary oncall.

dennis.s: I'll add a monitoring query to track alert churn (alerts/hour per rule) so we have measurable validation after the changes.

lucas.r: I'll also add a synthetic staging job to trigger the slow_request_rate so we can measure impact automatically.

sam.k: Opening PR shortly and will link test logs here when ready.

priya.v: Drafting policy now and will tag the initial pilot owner for validation and rollback steps.

maria.g: Thanks everyone. If anything slips, ping me. We want measurable SLO alignment, not just tuning for silence. I'll post the issue link and PR links in this thread when they're available. Closing thread for now; follow-up standup Mon 10:00. :heart:
